sql:
SELECT *
						FROM downloads n, downloads_desc nd
						WHERE n.did=nd.did 
						AND nd.lang='vn'
						AND n.display=1 						
						 and cat_id =7 AND namdwn_id=9 
					  ORDER BY d_order DESC , date_post DESC
